data.name: Aura of Righteousness
data.description: You gain DR 5/Evil and immunity to compulsion spells and spell-like abilities. Each ally within 10 feet or you gains a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against fear compulsion . This ability functions only while you are conscious, not if you are unconscious or dead.
